scope: Skills listed by the directory; this is not a complete inventory of every file in the repository.

skills.name: auth-guide
skills.description: Guide to setting up third-party authentication for a Notion Worker. Covers brokered credentials for external-service API keys / personal access tokens, OAuth, and plaintext environment secrets only when worker code needs the value. Use when the worker needs credentials for a non-Notion API, not for Notion API tokens or `ntn login`.

skills.name: connections
skills.description: Configure and use typed provider connections and connection-bound triggers in Notion App workflows.

skills.name: custom-blocks
skills.description: Build interactive browser custom blocks declared by a Notion App.

skills.name: notion-as-code
skills.description: Declare Notion pages, databases, teamspaces, and custom agents in an App, including data sources used by syncs.

skills.name: notion-database-designer
skills.description: Turns scattered notes and recurring work into useful Notion trackers for requests, content plans, or team work. Use to set up or improve a tracker, choosing its fields and views from the user's needs; ordinary record updates belong to the task's workflow.

skills.name: notion-knowledge-capture
skills.description: Captures conversations and supplied notes as Notion wiki pages, how-to guides, FAQs, decision records, or retrospectives. Use when saving or updating durable knowledge from existing context; use research-documentation when new source discovery and synthesis is the main task.

skills.name: notion-meeting-intelligence
skills.description: Prepares meeting agendas, internal pre-reads, and decision briefs using Notion context and relevant research. Use for meeting preparation, recurring meeting context, or updating meeting outcomes; use knowledge-capture for a standalone record of an existing discussion.

skills.name: notion-research-documentation
skills.description: Researches questions across Notion sources and synthesizes cited briefs, comparisons, or reports. Use when answering requires discovering and reconciling workspace information, optionally with external research, and returning or saving the findings.

skills.name: notion-spec-to-implementation
skills.description: Converts Notion product or technical specs into implementation plans, linked tasks, and evidence-based progress updates. Use for planning or implementing a spec, creating tasks from requirements, or reconciling implementation with spec changes.

skills.name: notion-weekly-project-digest
skills.description: Produces evidence-based weekly project or team updates by comparing reporting periods, tasks, decisions, and blockers in Notion. Use for recurring status digests; use spec-to-implementation for requirement-level implementation tracking.

skills.name: sync
skills.description: Build, debug, or review Notion App database syncs with stable keys and resumable pagination.

skills.name: sync-debug
skills.description: Diagnose a failing or misbehaving sync — fetch run logs, identify errors, cross-reference with code, and suggest fixes

skills.name: sync-guide
skills.description: Comprehensive guide to building Notion Workers syncs — covers the two-sync architecture (backfill+delta), replace mode, pagination, consistency buffers, pacers, deletion strategies, and common pitfalls. Auto-loads when sync-related work is detected.

skills.name: sync-validate
skills.description: Review a sync capability for common bugs — cursor advancement, pagination termination, state persistence, bi-modal correctness, consistency buffers, and deletion handling

skills.name: workflow
skills.description: Build or review Notion App workflows for typed triggers, durable replay-safe steps, and idempotent effects.

skills.name: workflow-guide
skills.description: Reference for typed triggers, durable steps, replay-safe data flow, and idempotent Workflow effects.

skills.name: workflow-validate
skills.description: Review Notion Worker Workflows for trigger typing and retry safety.
